pages.text: Make Vegetable Base, Clear Base, and tobacco extracts at the Extraction Station. Inputs are placed left to right; add normal furnace fuel below. JEI shows the five extraction recipes. Vegetable Base is VG and Clear Base is PG; the technical names stay in tooltips.

Fill the Liquid Blending Bench with both bases, optional nicotine, and up to three essences. Each reservoir holds 2000 mB. Add empty bottles, choose VG/PG and nicotine, and press Blend Bottle. Auto repeats the current formula. Empty ingredient bottles leave through Returns.

Put a blank Liquid Recipe Card in Recipe and press Save Recipe. It remembers the formula and can be renamed in an anvil to name the finished liquid. A saved card fixes its flavors even if a reservoir runs empty. Changing the ratio or nicotine clears the saved formula.

Sneak-use the Vape Pen to refill or charge. A redstone dust restores 20% charge. Hold use for a longer draw; more VG produces larger, longer-lived clouds. Nicotine strength changes the Nicotine effect, while nicotine-free liquids still produce clouds.

Create can produce the ingredients with heated Mixers. Leave one saved Recipe Card in each blending Basin. Combine VG and PG first, then add nicotine and one essence at a time. Every Basin uses two fluid inputs. Pipe the finished liquid to a Spout for bottling. The card is reusable.
